name: qualisoft-root
description: Qualisoft ERP - Orchestrateur de l'Architecture Elite MS RD 2030
author: Abdoulaye THIONGANE / Qualisoft

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(!process.version.startsWith('v20')){console.error('\x1b[31m[!] ERREUR CRITIQUE : Qualisoft nécessite Node 20 LTS.\x1b[0m');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACK,FRONT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: concurrently "npm run build --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend"
scripts.clean:matrix: rimraf .next node_modules && cd frontend && rimraf .next node_modules && cd ../backend && rimraf dist node_modules
